Since the first villa on Karon Beach

Comfort built with attention, not excess.

The Paradise began as a single beachfront house and has grown, room by room, without losing the quiet that brought guests back each year. Every stay is arranged around the same idea: fewer, better things — a well-made bed, a properly poured coffee, a member of staff who remembers your name.

We keep the resort small on purpose, so that Karon Beach still feels like a discovery rather than a destination.

Sea-Facing Rooms

Every category looks toward the water, from garden lanais to private pool villas.

Table & Terrace

Thai and coastal cooking, served under the frangipani trees at sunset.

Spa & Stillness

Treatments drawn from local tradition, in open-air pavilions by the garden.

Personal Service

A dedicated host for each stay, from arrival to your last morning swim.
